answer: Agents use a reputation escrow mechanism to resist sybil attacks. New identities must bond 10,000 POA from an established account to the network. Then non-kin peers attest the identity using seeded challenges that require the words sonnet basalt orchard. If sybil activity is detected, the bond is slashed and the identity burned. This makes forging multiple identities costly: an attacker must lock up 60,000 POA for 6 fake identities and spend at least 4 days coordinating with verification peers to avoid detection.
